description_en: Queries the list of HTTP incoming request header modification configurations for a site
description_zh: 查询站点的修改HTTP入站请求头配置列表
name: ListHttpIncomingRequestHeaderModificationRules

parameters.description_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.
parameters.description_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取。
parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.description_en: The configuration ID. You can call the ListHttpIncomingRequestHeaderModificationRules operation to obtain the configuration ID.
parameters.help_en: The configuration ID. You can call the ListHttpIncomingRequestHeaderModificationRules operation to obtain the configuration ID
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.description_en:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or rule configurations. Valid values:

- global: queries global configurations.
- rule: queries rule configurations.
parameters.description_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：

- global：查询全局配置；
- rule：查询规则配置；
